entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend pods were CPU‑throttled, causing request latency spikes and error rate increase.
entities.evidence: CPUThrottlingHigh (14 occurrences) and RequestLatency (51) & RequestErrorRate (91) alerts fire for namespace otel-demo, all referencing frontend pod/container.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Service performance degraded as a downstream effect of the throttled frontend pods.
entities.evidence: RequestLatency and RequestErrorRate alerts target the frontend service, showing high latency and errors.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Proxy observed increased errors due to upstream frontend failures.
entities.evidence: Error‑rate alerts propagate through the call chain defined in operational_topology.json where frontend‑proxy calls frontend.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/cart-service
entities.reasoning: Cart service calls frontend for product info and suffered downstream timeouts.
entities.evidence: Topology shows cart-service → frontend; frontend errors cause timeouts observed in request error alerts.

propagations.condition: CPU throttling reduced pod processing capacity
propagations.effect: Increased request latency and error rate observed at the service level
Proxy observed higher error counts and latency

propagations.condition: Frontend failures when cart queries product data
propagations.effect: Cart service experienced downstream errors and latency spikes

alerts_explained.explanation: Pods in otel-demo namespace exceed CPU throttling thresholds, indicating resource contention.
Observed request latency exceeds acceptable limits for services in otel-demo.
Error rate for HTTP requests in otel-demo crossed warning threshold.
Infrastructure alert that suppresses info‑level alerts; not directly related to the incident.
